signalRefresh.name: Suno
signalRefresh.whatChanged: Litigation escalated materially. American Federation of Musicians filed a NEW suit (2026-06-05, SDNY) against UMG/Warner over recordings licensed to Suno/Udio without credit or pay. Sony has settled with neither company; its fair-use case against Suno (D. Mass.) has a key summary-judgment hearing set for July 2026. Labels also moved to amend to add 61,000+ allegedly infringed songs. Warner settled in Nov 2025 (incl. Suno acquiring Songkick).
signalRefresh.recommendedAction: Crisis/narrative window is closing fast — the July summary-judgment hearing is a hard catalyst. If pitching, lead with crisis-comms / narrative-defense advisory or specialist overflow, NOT a generic retainer. Likely has in-house comms + incumbent agency; realistic entry is specialist support. Move within ~2-3 weeks or wait until post-ruling.
